skills.name: Unlock
skills.description: Diligently fulfills his role. Good effects on allies.  *ATK +260% (7 sec) *ATK Speed +260% (7 sec) *Critical Damage +260% (7 sec)

skills.name: Activate Trap!
skills.description: Uses a spike trap to attack enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 3600% Area Damage  *ATK per sec x 700% Area Damage (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Use Rate -60% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Delicious in Dungeon
abilities.description: Delicious in Dungeon Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Ally Clone
abilities.description: Has a set chance of summoning 1 allied team Ranger when Rangers deploy.　  - Flyer and Air Ambush Rangers are not eligible to be summoned in this way.  - The Abilities of allied Rangers summoned by this Ability won't activate. - Summoned Rangers won't consume any Mineral and will have no effects on redeploy times.
